heading: Introduction
paragraphs: He is a great luminary of the spiritual lineage of Hazrat Thanvi (R.A.) and a trusted, distinguished khalifa of Hazrat Maulana Shah Abdul Matin bin Husain Sahib (Pir Sahib) of Dhalkangar. He is the renowned founding principal of Madrasa Markazul Ihsan, Dhaka, and the respected khatib of Baitul Aman Jame Mosque, Badamtali, Dhaka. He is a widely respected scholar and spiritual guide.

heading: Lineage
paragraphs: Maulana Shah Tayyeb Ashraf Sahib was born in a highly noble and educated family in Kachua Upazila of Chandpur district. His respected father, Hafiz Muhammad Qutbuddin Sahib, was a great hafiz and the teacher of thousands of huffaz and scholars.

heading: Education
paragraphs: He completed his hifz at the madrasa of the world-renowned Hafiz Qari Abdul Haq Sahib. He then completed his religious education up to Dawra-e-Hadith (Master's equivalent) in 2002 at the traditional institution Madrasa Baitul Uloom Dhalkangar, Dhaka.

heading: Professional Life
paragraphs: Attracted by his sharp intellect and deep piety, the teachers of Madrasa Baitul Uloom Dhalkangar, Dhaka, appointed him as a teacher there, and he taught religious education with great honour and dignity for four years.
In 2006/07 he founded a religious educational institution named Madrasa Markazun Nur at Dhalkangar, Gendaria, Dhaka, where classes ran from primary level through Dawra-e-Hadith (Master's equivalent).

heading: Present Position and Service
paragraphs: At present he serves as the founding principal, mutawalli and education director of Madrasa Markazul Ihsan, Dhaka, established in 2018, discharging his duties with dedication, trustworthiness and efficiency. Under his prudent supervision and sincere efforts, the institution has become renowned as a unique centre for religious education, manners and character, self-purification (tazkiyah) and a Sunnah-based way of life. At present, about one thousand students receive religious education in two temporary buildings of the madrasa located at 6 Shaheed Faruk Road, West Jatrabari.

For nearly twelve years he has been delivering regular Friday sermons and bayans at Baitul Aman Steamerghat Jame Mosque, Badamtali, Dhaka. In addition, on the fourth Friday of every English month, he delivers the Friday sermon and bayan at Bonshree Central Jame Mosque, adjacent to Bonshree Ideal School.
